questions.question: If 31 January 2009 was a Saturday, then what was the day of the week on 30 January 2013?
questions.questionHtml: If 31 January 2009 was a Saturday, then what was the day of the week on 30 January 2013?
questions.solution:
From, 1 January 2009 to 31 January 2013 = 4 Years.

And, 4 years has 1 leap and 3 ordinary year

So total odd days = (1 × 2) + (3 × 1) = 2 + 3 = 5 odd days.

So, 31 January 2013 = Saturday + 5 = Thursday.

But, we need to find the day on 30 January 2013, so subtract 1 day from 31 January 2013.

Therefore, 30 January 2013 will be Thursday - 1 = Wednesday.

questions.question: Simplify the following expression. \(\frac{x^2-2 x-63}{x^2+14 x+49}\)
questions.questionHtml:
Simplify the following expression.

\(\frac{x^2-2 x-63}{x^2+14 x+49}\)
questions.solution: \(\frac{x^2-2 x-63}{x^2+14 x+49}\) ⇒ {x2 - 9x + 7x - 63}/{x2 + 7x + 7x + 49} ⇒ {x(x - 9) + 7 (x - 9)}/{x(x + 7) + 7(x + 7)} ⇒ {(x -9) × (x + 7)}/{(x + 7) × (x + 7)} ⇒ \(\frac{x-9}{x+7}\)

questions.question: The difference between a discount of 40% and two successive discounts of 30% on a certain bill was ₹220. Find the amount of the bill (in ₹).
questions.questionHtml: The difference between a discount of 40% and two successive discounts of 30% on a certain bill was ₹220. Find the amount of the bill (in ₹).
questions.solution:
Equivalent discount (D) = 30 + 30 -  (30 × 30)/100 ⇒ (60 - 9) = 51%

Difference in discount = (51 - 40)% = 220 ⇒ 11% = 220 ⇒ 1% = Rs.20

Marked price (M.P) = 100% = 20 × 100 = Rs.2000

questions.solution:
y + (1/y) = 4 ⇒ y3 + (1/y3) = (4)3 - 3 × 4 ⇒ y3 + (1/y3) = 64 - 12 = 52

⇒ {y3 + (1/y3)}2 = (52)2 ⇒ y6 + (1/y6) + 2 = 2704 ⇒ y6 + (1/y6) = (2704 - 2) = 2702

questions.questionHtml: A is 50% more efficient then B. B worked to finish the same work in 20 days. If A and B worked together, then how much time will they take to finish the same work?
questions.solution:
Efficiency of A : efficiency of B = 150 : 100 = 3 : 2

Total work = 20 × 2 = 40 units

Time taken to complete the work = 40/5 = 8 days

questions.question: What is the area of the sector of a circle of radius 8 cm formed by an arc of length 12 cm?
questions.questionHtml: What is the area of the sector of a circle of radius 8 cm formed by an arc of length 12 cm?

options.html: 45 cm2
47 cm2
48 cm2
84 cm2

questions.solution:
Length of an arc = (2 × π × R × θ)/360 ⇒ 12 × 360 = 2 × (22/7) × 8 × θ ⇒ θ = (12 × 360 × 7)/(22 × 16) ⇒ θ = (3 × 45 × 7)/11 ⇒ θ = (945/11)° 

Area of sector = (π × R2 × θ)/360 ⇒ (22/7) × (8)2 × (945/11) × (1/360) ⇒ 2 × 16 × 3 × (1/2) = 16 × 3 ⇒ 48 cm2

questions.questionHtml: The cost price of an article is decreased by 10% and then increased by 20%. If the final price is ₹540, then the original cost price is:

questions.question: The curved surface area of a solid circular cylinder of height 12 cm is 2640 cm 2 . What is the volume (in cm 3 ) of the cylinder? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.questionHtml: The curved surface area of a solid circular cylinder of height 12 cm is 2640 cm<sup>2</sup>. What is the volume (in cm<sup>3</sup>) of the cylinder? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
Curved surface area of cylinder = 2640 cm2 ⇒ 2 × π × R × H = 2640 ⇒ 22/7 × R × 12 = 1320 ⇒ 12 × R = 60 × 7 ⇒ R = 35 cm

The volume of cylinder = π × R2 × H ⇒ (22/7) × (35)2 × 12 ⇒ 22 × 5 × 35 × 12 = 46200 cm3

questions.question: The rate of simple interest for which ₹9,000 will amount to ₹10,200 in 4 years is:
questions.questionHtml: The rate of simple interest for which ₹9,000 will amount to ₹10,200 in 4 years is:
questions.solution:

Rate = (1200 × 100)/(9000 × 4) ⇒ (10/3) = 3\(1\over3\) %

questions.question: A boat running upstream takes 10 hours to cover a certain distance, while it takes 7 hours to cover the same distance running downstream. What is the ratio between the speed of the boat and that of the water current, respectively?
questions.questionHtml: A boat running upstream takes 10 hours to cover a certain distance, while it takes 7 hours to cover the same distance running downstream. What is the ratio between the speed of the boat and that of the water current, respectively?
questions.solution:
Time taken for upstream : time taken for downstream = 10 : 7; Speed for upstream : Speed for downstream = 7 : 10

Speed of boat : speed of stream = (10 + 7)/2 : (10 - 7)/2 ⇒ 17 : 3

questions.question: Two circles touch each other externally. The radius of the first circle with centre O is 6 cm. The radius of the second circle with centre P is 3 cm. Find the length of their common tangent AB.
questions.questionHtml: Two circles touch each other externally. The radius of the first circle with centre O is 6 cm. The radius of the second circle with centre P is 3 cm. Find the length of their common tangent AB.
questions.solution: Direct common tangent = 2 × √(R × r) ⇒ 2 × √(3 × 6) ⇒ 2 × 3 × √2 = 6√2 cm

questions.question: What is the value of 5√3 cos 60° tan 30° - 3 cos 0° + 3 cos 2 45° + 2 sin 2 60°?
questions.questionHtml: What is the value of 5√3 cos 60° tan 30° - 3 cos 0° + 3 cos<sup>2</sup> 45° + 2 sin<sup>2</sup> 60°?
questions.solution:
5√3 cos 60° tan 30° - 3 cos 0° + 3 cos2 45° + 2 sin2 60°

⇒ 5√3 × (1/2) × (1/√3)  - 3 × 1 + 3 × (1/√2)2  + 2 × (√3/2)2 ⇒ 5√3 × (1/2) × (1/√3)  - 3 + 3/2 + 3/2 ⇒ 5/2 - 3 + 3/2 + 3/2 ⇒ 2.5 - 3 + 3 ⇒ 2.5

questions.question: The effective speed of a boat is 15.2 km/h against the stream and 20.8 km/h along the stream. Find the speed of the stream.
questions.questionHtml: The effective speed of a boat is 15.2 km/h against the stream and 20.8 km/h along the stream. Find the speed of the stream.
questions.solution:
Upstream speed = (U - V) = 15.2 km/h. Downstream speed = (U + V) = 20.8 km/h

Speed of stream (V) = (20.8 - 15.2)/2 = 5.6/2 = 2.8 km/h

questions.question: 2 men can finish a work in 6 days and 3 women can finish the same work in 4 days. In how many days will the work be finished by 1 man and 2 women, working together every day?
questions.questionHtml: 2 men can finish a work in 6 days and 3 women can finish the same work in 4 days. In how many days will the work be finished by 1 man and 2 women, working together every day?
questions.solution:
2M × 6 = 3W × 4 ⇒ M/W = 1/1

Total work = 3W × 4 = 3 × 1 × 4 = 12 units 

Time taken to complete the work by 1 man and 2 woman = 12/(1 + 2) = 12/3 = 4 days

questions.question: In the first month, the income of Mohan increases by 30%. In the second month his income decreases by 30%. What will be percentage increase or decrease in the income after two months?

questions.solution: Effective percentage change in salary = 30 - 30 - (30 × 30)/100 ⇒ 0 - 9 = - 9%

questions.question: If \(\cos ^2 θ=\frac{3}{4}\) , where θ is an acute angle, then the value of sin (θ + 30°) is:
questions.questionHtml: If \(\cos ^2 θ=\frac{3}{4}\), where θ is an acute angle, then the value of sin (θ + 30°) is:
questions.solution:
Cos2 θ = 3/4 ⇒ cos θ = √(3/4) = √3/2 ⇒ cos θ  = cos 30° ⇒ θ = 30° 

sin (θ + 30°) =  sin (30° + 30°) ⇒ sin 60° = √3/2

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. Does she prepare the lesson?

Does she prepare the lesson?

options.text: Is the lesson prepared by her?
options.html: Is the lesson prepared by her?

options.text: Is the lesson being prepared by her?

questions.solution: The subject of the sentence is "she". The verb is "prepare". To change the sentence into passive voice, we need to make the object of the sentence (the lesson) the subject and add the auxiliary verb "be" and the past participle of the main verb (prepared).

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. And also, they contribute to the development of social and environmental solutions for the planet's future. B. Companies do play an important role in modern society. C. Because of their systematic relevance and their impact on policy-making, companies must use their influence in ways that benefit the public good. D. Some corporations have become so large that their activities and strategic decisions have a direct impact on government policy and citizens' lives.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. And also, they contribute to the development of social and environmental solutions for the planet's future.

B. Companies do play an important role in modern society.

C. Because of their systematic relevance and their impact on policy-making, companies must use their influence in ways that benefit the public good.

D. Some corporations have become so large that their activities and strategic decisions have a direct impact on government policy and citizens' lives.
questions.solution: Companies wield significant influence on society, with some becoming so large that they directly impact government policies and citizens' lives. It's essential for them to use this influence ethically, contributing to social and environmental solutions for the planet's future (BDCA).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence. I just went to Bali on a backpacking trip and did everything by the ear without any itinerary.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.

I just went to Bali on a backpacking trip and did everything by the ear without any itinerary.
questions.solution: The idiom "by the ear" means to do something without a plan or itinerary, relying on improvisation and spontaneity. Example: Without any preparation, Jane decided to explore the city by the ear, wandering through its streets without a map or agenda. This phrase is often used in the context of travel or performance.

questions.question: Select the option that is OPPOSITE in meaning to the given word. Jubilant
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that is OPPOSITE in meaning to the given word.

Jubilant
questions.solution: Jubilant means feeling or expressing great happiness and triumph. Example: The team was jubilant after winning the championship. Marked option Melancholic means feeling or expressing sadness or depression. Example: Despite the festivities, her face remained melancholic, revealing a hidden sorrow.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. Changing secret and coded messages in a readable form
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Changing secret and coded messages in a readable form
questions.solution: Decoding means changing secret and coded messages into a readable form. It is a process opposite to encoding. Example: The spy had to decode the message to understand the enemy's plan.

questions.question: Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence. Successful people often have a role modal who inspired them to greatness.
questions.questionHtml:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

Successful people often have a role modal who inspired them to greatness.
questions.solution: The correct spelling of the word in the sentence is 'model', not 'modal'. Model refers to a person who serves as an example or inspiration for others to follow. Example: The teacher, with her unwavering dedication to education, became a model for all educators in the school.

questions.question: Choose the option that rectifies the incorrectly spelt underlined word. Mr. Singh is a phenomenally sucsesful salesperson.
questions.questionHtml:
Choose the option that rectifies the incorrectly spelt underlined word.

Mr. Singh is a phenomenally sucsesful salesperson.
questions.solution: The correct spelling of the word is 'successful'. Successful means achieving a desired outcome or result, often characterized by the accomplishment of goals, prosperity, or the attainment of a positive position. Example: After years of hard work and determination, she built a successful career in the tech industry.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Grow
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Grow
questions.solution: Grow means to increase in size or quantity. Example: The company implemented effective strategies, leading to a significant grow in its market share. Marked option shrink means to decrease in size or quantity. Example: Due to economic challenges, the company had to shrink its workforce to maintain financial stability.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. Enjoying or affording warm secure shelter or cover and opportunity for ease and contentment
questions.questionHtml:

Enjoying or affording warm secure shelter or cover and opportunity for ease and contentment
questions.solution: Snug is a one-word substitute for the given group of words. It means enjoying or affording warm secure shelter or cover and opportunity for ease and contentment. Example: She felt snug in her cosy blanket on the chilly winter evening.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. Kind, generous, and forgiving.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Kind, generous, and forgiving.
questions.solution: Magnanimous means generous and forgiving, which perfectly captures the meaning of the group of words given in the question. The word comes from the Latin roots Magnus (great) and animus (soul), so it literally means having a great soul. Example: Despite being wronged by his friend, John showed a magnanimous spirit and forgave him.

questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. You wash / the dishes / and / I dry the same.
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

You wash / the dishes / and / I dry the same.
questions.solution: The phrase 'I dry the same' is grammatically incorrect as it does not make sense in the given context. A more grammatically correct version would be: 'I dry them', where 'them' refers to the dishes.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence. A. As a nation, India is a united country and shall always remain so. B. As nation, India is a united country and shall always remain so. C. As the nation, India is a united country and shall always remain so. D. As a nation, India is an united country and shall always remain so.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the grammatically correct sentence.

A. As a nation, India is a united country and shall always remain so.

B. As nation, India is a united country and shall always remain so.

C. As the nation, India is a united country and shall always remain so.

D. As a nation, India is an united country and shall always remain so.
questions.solution: The correct answer is Option 1: A. As a nation, India is a united country and shall always remain so. The sentence is grammatically correct because it uses the indefinite article "a" before "nation" to show that India is one of many nations, and not the only one.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. I take my _____ off to our freedom fighters for their service to our country.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I take my _____ off to our freedom fighters for their service to our country.
questions.solution: The phrase "take my hat off to" is an idiom that means to show respect or admiration for someone. Example: I have to take my hat off to Sarah for completing the marathon despite facing numerous challenges and never giving up. The sentence expresses admiration for freedom fighters and their service to the country.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. _____ droplets settled on top of leaves.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

_____ droplets settled on top of leaves.
questions.solution: "Dew" refers to small water droplets that form on surfaces, especially during the night when the air is cooler. Example: As the sun set and the temperature dropped, the grassy meadow became adorned with glistening dew. The sentence describes how dew settled on top of leaves.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank. Instead of becoming joyous to hear the breaking news, she became _________.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank.

Instead of becoming joyous to hear the breaking news, she became _________.
questions.solution: Joyous means experiencing or expressing great happiness or delight. Example: The entire community gathered for a joyous celebration filled with laughter, music, and heartfelt moments. So we need an antonym that conveys a negative or sad emotion. Melancholic means feeling sad or depressed. Example: As the sun set behind the mountains, a melancholic melody played, evoking a sense of nostalgia.

questions.solution: "Aptitude for" is the correct preposition to use with the noun "aptitude." "Aptitude for" means a natural ability or skill in a particular area. Example: She has an aptitude for languages.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Predicament
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Predicament
questions.solution: Predicament means a difficult or challenging situation. Example: Faced with a financial predicament, she had to make tough decisions to navigate through the tough times. questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word. His knowledge is superficial in nature.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

His knowledge is superficial in nature.
questions.solution: Superficial means shallow or lacking depth. Example: Wearing only a superficial smile, she concealed the depth of her emotions. Marked option Profound means deep or thorough. questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
questions.solution: The verb "revolves" means to move in a circular motion around a central point. The sentence suggests that something is moving around a central point, which fits the definition of "revolves".

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
questions.solution: Transmit means to send or convey something from one place to another. It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank, as it fits with the context of communication. questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
questions.solution: Drawbacks refer to the negative aspects or disadvantages of something. It is a noun and can be used in a sentence like: "The drawbacks of using this software are its high cost and steep learning curve." It is often used in contrast to the advantages or benefits of something.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
questions.solution: Confidential means private or secret information that is not meant to be shared with others. Example: The contents of the document are confidential and must not be shared with unauthorized individuals. This option is the most appropriate to fill in the blank because it fits the context of the sentence, which suggests that the information being referred to is sensitive or private.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
questions.solution: Outweigh means to be more important, valuable, or significant than something else. It is a verb and is often used in the context of comparing two things or options. Example: The benefits of exercise outweigh the costs of a gym membership.
